verdict.rationale: An online tax e-services portal could plausibly offer event-triggered automation such as alerts or automatic payments, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only manual e-filing, batch enrollment files, and logins, with no user-definable rules or event triggers. Subscribing to tax publications is an adjacent feature, not a rule-based automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
